description: Java class for an Android activity demonstrating overlay window display and permission handling.

classes.name: OverlayWindowActivity
classes.description: An activity that manages overlay window display, including permission requests and overlay creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and sets button click listeners.

methods.name: mShowOverlayListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that checks overlay permission and initiates overlay drawing.

methods.name: mHideOverlayListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that removes the overlay view if present.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from permission settings activity and proceeds to draw overlay if permitted.

methods.name: drawOverlay
methods.description: Creates and displays a TextView as an overlay window with specific layout parameters.
